resources.string: Lock your own Private DNS setting so you can\'t casually turn it off.
Not set up yet. Follow the steps below once to enable locking.
Unlocked. Private DNS can be changed normally in Settings.
Locked to %1$s. The Private DNS entry in Settings is greyed out.

This app locks Private DNS using Android\'s Device Owner API, which needs to be granted once from a computer via ADB — there is no in-app permission prompt for it. It only works on a profile with no accounts added yet, so do this right after a factory reset (or on a fresh secondary user). Connect the phone with USB debugging enabled and run:
Tap the command above to copy it.
Lock for how many minutes (0 = unlock any time)
Enter 0 or a positive number of minutes
Could not set that host as Private DNS — check the hostname and your connection

This clears the Private DNS lock permanently and gives up the permission that makes locking possible. You would need to factory reset (or use a fresh user) to set it up again. Only do this if you\'re done using the app.
Device admin was disabled — locking no longer works until re-provisioned.
